items.title: If Whittemore is right: products keep improving and prices fall
items.body: Cheaper models like Haiku 5.5 and ChatGPT's generated interfaces would make AI tools cheaper and simpler to use in a surgery. Meta's Muse adding connectors for business tools suggests more small-business automation within a year.

items.title: If Zitron is right: financing stress reaches suppliers
items.body: If credit tightens, AI companies could raise prices, cut free tiers or merge. A practice should avoid being dependent on a single AI supplier and keep its records in portable formats.

items.title: Cyber risk is the immediate, shared concern
items.body: Dimon says cyber risk is up tenfold after Mythos. NHS general practice is a plausible target, so basic hygiene, patching, multi-factor authentication and backups matter more than any AI tool.
